Digest.title: In service of the museum
Digest.titleSubtitle: Experience guidelines for the museum-educational institution
Digest.introParagraph1: A friendlier explanation of the research project for the 2026 Graphic Design capstone at UEMG. The project is conceived and carried out by Nicoly Dandara and Letícia França, advised by Simone Souza.
Digest.introParagraph2: Here we strip out the academic jargon and give you a calmer way into the subject.

Collaborate.title: Collaborate
Collaborate.body: This page will gather the ways to collaborate with the research. The contact form is still on its way — for now, this is just a placeholder for where it'll live.
